_: A table is one independent race loop with its own pool. minPlayers counts wallets that have bet (0 = the race always runs). bots 'house' adds labelled house stakes, capped by botBudget (token units); 'none' means every unit in the pool is a player's. token omitted = the default token, or the show on data/schedule.json. startOn 'bet' keeps a round open (no clock, no house stakes) until the first player bets; 'timer' (the default) starts the lobby clock with the round.
